new_candidates.body:
## Bug report

**Required Info:**

- Operating System:
  - Ubuntu 26.04.1 LTS (resolute) on Docker
- Computer:
  - N/A
- ROS2 Version:
  - Lyrical Luth
- Version or commit hash:
  - ros-lyrical-nav2-simple-commander                  1.5.1-1resolute.20260813.024902
- DDS implementation:
  - FastDDS (default)

#### Steps to reproduce issue
```
ros2 launch nav2_simple_commander  security_demo_launch.py
```

#### Expected behavior
A demo that works.

#### Actual behavior
```
[demo_security-9] [INFO] [1794782448.518771036] [basic_navigator]: Nav2 is ready for use!
[demo_security-9] Traceback (most recent call last):
[demo_security-9]   File "/opt/ros/lyrical/lib/nav2_simple_commander/demo_security", line 33, in <module>
[demo_security-9]     sys.exit(load_entry_point('nav2-simple-commander==1.0.0', 'console_scripts', 'demo_security')())
[demo_security-9]              ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^^
[demo_security-9]   File "/opt/ros/lyrical/lib/python3.14/site-packages/nav2_simple_commander/demo_security.py", line 70, in main
[demo_security-9]     go_through_poses_task = navigator.goThroughPoses(route_poses)
[demo_security-9]   File "/opt/ros/lyrical/lib/python3.14/site-packages/nav2_simple_commander/robot_navigator.py", line 227, in goThroughPoses
[demo_security-9]     self.info(f'Navigating with {len(poses.goals)} goals....')
[demo_security-9]                                      ^^^^^^^^^^^
[demo_security-9] AttributeError: 'list' object has no attribute 'goals'
```

#### Reproduction instructions

#### Additional information
I understand that goThroughPoses now expects a nav_msgs/Goals message, but the installed demo still passes a plain list of poses. I'm not entirely sure what motivated the change. I would suggest some basic CI check on these perhaps could help prevent unnoticed breaks in the future. 

Related, in the [demo section](https://github.com/ros-navigation/navigation2/tree/main/nav2_simple_commander#usage-of-demos-and-examples), there are references to https://github.com/aws-robotics/aws-robomaker-small-warehouse-world, but that seems to be unmaintained (indeed, I can't find a package for Lyrical Luth).
new_candidates.title: security_demo broken on Lyrical Luth
